basics.name: CHAMATH DILSHAN
basics.label: Associate Software Engineer
basics.summary: Motivated Software Engineer with hands-on experience building full-stack web and mobile applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python (FastAPI), React, React Native, and Node.js. Skilled in designing RESTful APIs, modeling relational/NoSQL databases, and shipping production-ready features end to end. Comfortable in agile, Git-based teams, with working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

work.name: Applantics (PVT) Ltd
highlights: Contributed to application development, debugging, backend integration, and feature testing across live client projects.
Collaborated with senior engineers on code reviews and release preparation, gaining exposure to production-quality development standards and real project delivery timelines.
Learned and applied additional technologies on the job, including Laravel, Electron, and Flutter, to support cross-platform feature development.

work.name: Institute of Java Software Engineering, Panadura, SL
highlights: Developed scalable full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and React, ensuring responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
Designed, built, and integrated RESTful APIs, optimizing MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB queries, and worked with GitHub-based CI practices.
Applied debugging, testing, and performance optimization strategies within agile, Git-based team workflows.

work.name: Freelancer.com / Fiverr
highlights: Delivered end-to-end client solutions from requirements through deployment, hosting, and production release with strong client satisfaction.
Designed and developed responsive websites and mobile-friendly interfaces using modern web technologies and usability-focused layouts.
Combined graphic design, UI/UX design, and front-end web development to deliver polished, client-ready products.
Managed multiple projects independently, coordinating timelines, client communications, and deliverables effectively.

projects.name: VibeNet
projects.description: Secure Real-Time End-to-End Encrypted Chat Platform
highlights: Frontend: Built a real-time E2EE chat client using Next.js 16 and TypeScript with Web Crypto API-based encryption, styled with Tailwind CSS and deployed live on Vercel.
Backend: Developed a Go backend with WebSocket-based real-time messaging and DynamoDB/PostgreSQL for data storage, deployed on AWS EC2 with automated CI/CD pipelines.
Architected the system as a multi-repository monorepo with Git submodules, comprehensive architecture documentation, and an AWS infrastructure setup guide.

projects.name: RevvUp
highlights: Built a premium multi-showroom motorbike marketplace with a React Native (Expo) client and a FastAPI backend deployed serverless on Vercel.
Integrated Supabase for authentication, data storage, and Google sign-in, and automated Android release builds with GitHub Actions.
projects.url: Main Application | Backend API | Frontend CI/CD

projects.name: FinFlow
highlights: Developed a cross-platform personal finance app (React Native, Expo, NativeWind) with Google authentication and a real-time expense tracking UI.
Built an async FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, PostgreSQL, and JWT-secured REST endpoints, documented with Swagger.

projects.name: Nexa G Bucket Manager
highlights: Built a GCP-backed private/public cloud file manager (React Native/Expo, FastAPI, Supabase, Google Cloud Storage).
Automated Android APK builds and releases with GitHub Actions, including secrets injection and versioned release publishing.

projects.name: Distributed Microservices Architecture
highlights: Engineered a scalable microservices platform using Spring Cloud with API Gateway, Config Server, and Eureka Service Registry.
Developed loosely coupled services (User, Menu, Order, Kitchen) with centralized Git-based configuration and Docker Compose infrastructure (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

projects.name: JobMail
highlights: Built a Next.js application for generating and sending professional job application emails with real-time preview and multiple templates.
Integrated Firebase Authentication, Gmail API (OAuth + attachments), and Outlook mailto workflows; deployed live at jobemail.me.

projects.name: SpendSight
highlights: Built a cross-platform React Native finance app with NativeWind and Firebase for expense tracking, account management, and secure authentication.

projects.name: TaskFlow
highlights: Built a modern authentication system with Laravel 12 and Tailwind CSS, featuring custom sign-up/sign-in pages and a polished UI, deployed on Railway.

projects.name: PowerAlert
highlights: Built a full-stack utility monitoring platform with RESTful APIs, JWT-based access control, and responsive real-time monitoring workflows.

projects.name: Ceylonic & create-stack-cli
highlights: create-stack-cli: Built a universal, interactive CLI scaffolder for React, Vue, Angular, and Vanilla JS projects with optional TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, and Prettier integration, published as an open-source npm package.

ceylonic: Developed a zero-dependency TypeScript utility library for Sri Lanka-specific data NIC parsing/validation plus Sinhala date, currency, and number formatting published as an npm package under the MIT license.

projects.name: GCP Cloud Storage APIs and Cloud-Based Applications
highlights: Built a Spring Boot REST API migrating local file storage to Google Cloud Storage with multi-environment deployment profiles.
Developed a Vue.js student management system backed by GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) and Cloud Functions.
projects.url: Image Cloud Storage API | Student Management Cloud App
